evidence.summary: With all other parameters held constant, the score increased from 0.9430 at loan_amount=1 to 0.9707 at loan_amount=50, then decreased to 0.9648 at loan_amount=100. This indicates a non-monotonic effect in the tested range.

With all other parameters held constant, the score decreased from 0.9707 at credit_history=300.559 to 0.9676 at 500.559 and further to 0.9487 at 811.559. This provides consistent evidence that increasing credit_history decreases the score in the tested range.
